content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I would like to know if it's possible to upgrade a [product_name] demo to the full version.
Hi, Unfortunately, it is not possible to upgrade the demo version directly. You need to purchase an official full version.
Thank you for your quick reply. Could you please guide me on how to purchase the full version? I tried searching for it on the [company_name] portal but could not find it. Thanks in advance.
You will need to contact a [company_name] representative in your local area. [company_name] operates in over 190 countries.
A full version of [product_name] cannot be downloaded. You are required to buy the DVD. [product_name] DVD, [article_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to upgrade from a demo to a full version of [product_name], but find the process unclear and complicated. The full version is currently only available as a physical DVD purchase, which creates obstacles for those hoping for a simple online upgrade or download. Users face uncertainty regarding digital upgrade options and purchasing procedures.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to upgrade the demo version of [product_name] to the full version conveniently online, preferably through a direct download or portal purchase.
